en: Sepia-toned vintage view from a high rocky cliff with a multi‑storey villa or hotel perched right on the edge, featuring arched windows and a large balcony overlooking a wide valley. Below lies a town along a river with bridges and gridded streets, surrounded by mountains. A cable‑car line with pylons and a suspended cabin runs between the cliff and the valley, indicating a tourist or scenic transport route.
